doc.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007

title: Personality conflicts among musicians
summary: Domber says artists have egos and conflicts, which he smooths over or avoids.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: As a producer of these things, did you ever have to deal with personality conflicts between the musicians?

Well when you’re dealing with musicians you’re dealing with artists. When you’re dealing with artists there are always personality issues, there’s always ego — this guy doesn’t like the other guy, this guy had a gig but he never invited me to play with him so I don’t want to play with him. You know you always have things of that kind that go on. Usually you can help smooth it over. Sometimes you just make sure that they stay separated.
